maintenanceCapex.estimate: Depreciation ($228.9M rental and non-rental) used as maintenance capex proxy, scaled with revenue in stress. Gross rental capex was $457.0M.

caveats: JUDGMENT, floorplan: $657.4M of floorplan is left out of debt under the dealer convention. $366.2M of it is a non-trade PNC bank facility at SOFR+3.00%, which behaves closer to funded debt. Including it raises debt to $2,027M.
ESTIMATE, debt service: uses non-floorplan interest expense ($104.9M), not cash. Cash interest is reported only in total.
NOTE, D&A: cash-flow D&A exceeds income-statement D&A by $8.0M, not itemized by the company.
ASSUMPTION, years in business: 4, from the 2021 merger, because the filing states no earlier founding year. Predecessor businesses are older, so this understates the operating history.
